welcome.title: Welcome to SniShaper
welcome.subtitle: Please select your preferred language to get started

s1.title: Start the Proxy
s1.text: Click the highlighted "Start Proxy" button to launch the local proxy.

s2.title: System Proxy
s2.text: Now click "System Proxy" so browser traffic is automatically routed through the proxy.

s3.title: Use Rules
s3.text: The Rules page ships with official rules applying MITM, TLS fragmentation, QUIC and more per site group. Create your own groups here; domains outside the rules are routed automatically via the GFWList.

s4.title: Install the Certificate
s4.text: MITM, QUIC and other modes need the root certificate. When it is not installed, the Dashboard offers a one-click install prompt; this section shows and manages installed certificates.

s5.title: TUN Mode
s5.text: Enable TUN under "Settings → TUN" (admin rights required) when every app should use the proxy without extra configuration.

s6.title: Learn More
s6.text: Congrats on finishing the basics! For advanced features (CLI, DNS, Cloudflare IP selection, Evolution mode, etc.) visit the GitHub Wiki, and check the FAQ first when you run into problems.

routing.title: Auto Routing
routing.feature_smart_desc: Prioritizes detecting Cloudflare sites for ECH IP injection, otherwise uses TLS fragmentation to bypass SNI blocking.
routing.feature_priority_desc: Manually defined 'Rules' have the highest priority. Auto routing applies if no rules match.

notifications.saved_desc: New auto routing policy has been applied.

network.ipv6_ok_desc: A global IPv6 address exists on this network. IPv6 features (NAT64 mapping, IPv6 DNS policy, evolution test IPv6 option) are available.
network.ipv6_disabled_desc: No usable global IPv6 address was detected. NAT64 and IPv6 DNS policies can still be configured, but they will fail to connect on an IPv4-only network (they never fall back to IPv4 silently). They take effect once IPv6 is detected. A check runs every 10 minutes, or use the button to re-check now.
network.ipv6_disabled: IPv4-only network: IPv6 rules (NAT64, IPv6 DNS) cannot take effect
network.ipv6_only_will_fail: IPv4-only network: IPv6-only will fail to connect
network.ipv6_nat64_will_fail: IPv4-only network: NAT64 requires IPv6 to work
network.ipv6_warn_suffix: IPv4-only environment: IPv6 connectivity cannot be tested
network.ipv6_restored: IPv6 detected: NAT64, IPv6 rules and other features are back

settings.title: Settings

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: Switch between light, dark, or system theme.

auto_start.title: Start on Boot
auto_start.desc: Run automatically in background after Windows login.

auto_proxy.title: Auto-enable proxy on startup
auto_proxy.desc: Proxy will be enabled immediately after application starts.

auto_sysproxy.title: Set system proxy on auto-enable
auto_sysproxy.desc: Also enable the system proxy when the proxy is auto-enabled at startup. Disable to start the local proxy service only.

auto_update_rules.title: Auto-update rules
auto_update_rules.desc: Check GitHub for the latest rules on every start and merge them in. Rules are only added and updated; rules you edited yourself are never overwritten.

show_main.title: Show main window on startup
show_main.desc: If disabled, the app will only run in the tray when auto-started.

min_to_tray.title: Minimize to Tray
min_to_tray.desc: Hide to tray instead of exiting when clicking close.

settings.port_desc: HTTP and SOCKS5 share this port.

lan_sharing.title: LAN Sharing
lan_sharing.desc: Allow other devices in the local network to connect.

tun_mode.title: TUN Mode
tun_mode.desc: Force all traffic through TUN for global proxying.

ca_management.title: CA Management
ca_management.reset_hint: This will delete the current cert and generate a new one.
ca_management.reset_success_desc: New root certificate generated. Please reinstall it.

logs.title: Log Files
logs.desc: Logs are saved to the log folder next to the app; each run creates a new timestamped file.

notifications.port_invalid: Please enter a valid port between 1 and 65535

theme.label: Color Scheme
theme.desc: Choose the interface color scheme (both support dark/light mode).

update_channel.title: Release Channel
update_channel.desc: Select the release channel to receive updates. Update checks are filtered by this channel.
update_channel.alpha: Alpha (Preview): fastest feature iteration, lowest stability, for early adopters
update_channel.beta: Beta (Testing): includes some new features, may contain defects, for test feedback
update_channel.rc: Release Candidate: close to the official release, only critical fixes
update_channel.stable: Stable: official releases only, recommended for most users

download_source.title: Download Source
download_source.desc: Pick the download source for update packages. Smart mode measures every mirror and uses the fastest; a specific mirror is tried first, falling back to direct and the other mirrors.

outbound_iface.title: Outbound interface
outbound_iface.desc: Which NIC carries TUN outbound traffic. By default it is chosen automatically from the system default route, avoiding VMware / Hyper-V / container virtual adapters.

stack.title: TUN network stack
stack.desc: gvisor has the widest compatibility; mixed offloads TCP to the system; system is kernel-mode with the lowest overhead.

adapter_name.title: Virtual adapter name
adapter_name.desc: Name of the TUN virtual adapter. Leave empty to use the default name SniShaper.

route_exclude.title: Excluded networks
route_exclude.desc: These networks bypass the tunnel and follow the system default route. Comma-separated CIDRs.

evolution.title: Evolution Mode
evolution.subtitle: Auto-test domain connectivity and generate optimal rules
evolution.test_flow_desc: Successful domains auto-generate temp rules. Convert to permanent rules in the Rules tab.
evolution.empty_rules_desc: Successful domains will generate temp rules after testing
evolution.empty_results_desc: Enter domains in the Test tab and start testing
evolution.confirm_desc: Convert this temp rule to a permanent rule and write to config?
